name: Recital N
title: REPORT on the role of cohesion policy in supporting the just transition
part_text: whereas nuclear energy is included in the green taxonomy and whereas, therefore, it contributes to the transition towards a decarbonised economy; whereas more investment in that energy form would help to achieve the EU’s strategic autonomy and carbon emission reduction goals; whereas, further, that energy source would be an effective replacement with regard to energy performance, job creation and economic growth in transition regions;
